# The UI regression script (`Libertty --ui-probe`): real AppKit key events
# at the real window, off screen and never focused.
#
# Typed text must reach the program exactly as typed — upper case, spaces
# and the shifted symbols (@ # %) that Claude Code used to receive as bare
# digits through the kitty keyboard protocol.
type:echo UI-PROBE-OK
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:UI-PROBE-OK
type:printf "at=@ pct=%% hash=# tilde=~ quote=\" done\n"
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:at=@ pct=% hash=# tilde=~ quote=" done
expect-not:never-typed-this
# ⌃C must interrupt the program, not type a letter: the command after it
# only runs if the shell came back to its prompt.
type:sleep 20
key:enter
wait:0.6
key:ctrl+c
wait:0.5
type:echo AFTER-CTRL-C
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:AFTER-CTRL-C
shot:ui-probe.png
# ⌘-clicking a program's link to a file that would run (an app, an
# executable) asks first; documents and folders open.
expect-runs:/bin/ls=yes
expect-runs:/System/Applications/Calculator.app=yes
expect-runs:/etc/hosts=no
expect-runs:/usr/share/dict/words=no
expect-runs:/tmp=no
